# StoryStage

The stage dressing current at a page or choice menu: the backdrop and the
character portraits standing on stage.

## Parameters

- `bg`: A [StoryImage](StoryImage.md) object. Backdrop image. `None` = flat dark fill. Optional.
- `left`: A [StoryImage](StoryImage.md) object. Portrait at stage left. Optional.
- `center`: A [StoryImage](StoryImage.md) object. Portrait at stage center. Optional.
- `right`: A [StoryImage](StoryImage.md) object. Portrait at stage right. Optional.
